title: The Clock Tower Chimes Calculation
description:
The clock tower chimes 4 prelude notes at the top of the hour, followed by deep gongs matching the hour.
The detective hears 4 prelude chimes followed by 10 deep gongs.
question: What time is it?
hints: 4 prelude chimes signal top of the hour.
Count of deep gongs = Hour of the day (10 gongs = 10 o'clock).
solution_explanation: The 4 prelude chimes signal the top of the hour, and the 10 deep gongs indicate 10 o'clock (10:00).
